meta.name: CCNL per i lavoratori addetti all'industria delle calzature

notes.text: SALARY MODEL: conglobated (minimi retributivi include paga base, contingenza, and EDR). Modeled as base_salary with fixed_allowances: [] for all levels, level 8 included (the IND_FUN of the quadri is not modelled). Confirmed by stable coefficient ratios across all tranche dates (review of 2026-10-30).

LEVEL 1 SPECIAL TRANCHE: separate wage correction from 1 January 2025 (EUR 1,502.46, up from EUR 1,315.70 at Aug 2024), independent of standard tranche dates Aug 2024/Aug 2025/Aug 2026. Confirmed by fiscoetasse.com (rinnovo 2024) and web search: Jan 2025=1502.46, Aug 2025=1530.00, Aug 2026=1557.00. Modeled as a four-period series for level 1 only.
SENIORITY (Art. 46, p. 97 of the text of 17 July 2024): five increments, 'i primi quattro con cadenza biennale ed il quinto dopo un quadriennio', of 6.89 (1st) to 12.24 (8th) EUR a month.

limitation.remediation: Resolved: cadence and amounts read in art. 46 of the 2024 text on 2026-11-06.

notes.text: Workers covered: approximately 75,000 (Assocalzaturifici member companies). Agreement signed 2024-07-17; valid 2024-01-01 to 2026-12-31.
INPS rates from 2026-industria.json (same sector as metalmeccanico). IRPEF 2026 brackets applied (L. 199/2025).

APPRENTICESHIP (professionalizzante): 80/90/100% in three periods. Total duration 36 months per Art. apprendistato. Period splits by level group: L6-L8=10/10/16m, L3-L5=11/11/14m, L2-L2S=12/12/12m. L1 not eligible as destination. Source: CCNL 2024-07-17 Assocalzaturifici (D121), circolare apprendistato; businessonline.it article 2024; kitech.it scheda D121.

APPRENTICE SENIORITY (Art. 23 Apprendistato, p. 52 of the CCNL industria delle calzature 17 July 2024, https://www.falc.biz/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/CCNL-contratto-collettivo-nazionale-di-lavoro-calzaturiero-2024.pdf, sha256 fd48de9dd4aa81fd5ca97c3dd94099d085ac61666831e6da37fe2fbab19558cf): 'L’anzianità durante il rapporto di apprendistato è utile per la maturazione e per la corresponsione degli aumenti periodici di anzianità. Gli aumenti saranno commisurati alle stesse percentuali del minimo contrattuale': the level increments, reduced by the apprenticeship percentage (seniority_increments.apprentice_level_amount and apprentice_pct_scaled).

provenance.note: Number of monthly payments read from the contract file; no clause is cited for it.

location.quote: Il lavoratore avrà diritto a maturare un massimo di cinque aumenti periodici di anzianità, di cui i primi quattro con cadenza biennale ed il quinto dopo un quadriennio.

provenance.transformation: Two tiers: four increments every 24 months, then one after 48 months; the amounts of art. 46 per level (3S as 3, 2S as 2).

location.section: Art. 112 - Aumenti retributivi e nuovi minimi contrattuali
location.quote: L'indennità di funzione pari ad € 41,31 mensili prevista ai lavoratori con qualifica di quadro dal 1° Settembre 1995 viene mantenuta. Tale indennità è assorbibile dai superminimi individuali.

provenance.transformation: EUR 41.31 a month, paid with the role 'quadro' on level 8, the level of the quadri in this ruleset (the renewal does not restate which levels hold the qualifica). It is absorbable by individual superminimi: the caller states a superminimo net of the part that absorbs the allowance. Dated from the renewal that maintains it (1 August 2024).
